a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to generate up to 8 first means we almost certainly both die after round 1. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us immediately. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you'd rather propose another split, say so, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every remaining round so you can reach 4. Take as soon as the reserve has 4 or more. I won't take any more.
Operating with you every round. Take the cells as soon as the reserve can get you to 4.
